answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a canyon as the anchor of the cost.
